component.name: eParna
component.summary: A fast, lightweight, cross-platform ebook reader

description.p: eParna is a fast, lightweight, cross-platform desktop ebook reader written in pure Rust. The name comes from Sanskrit parṇa — "leaf" — so eParna is literally an "e-leaf": a light, quiet place to read.

Features include a library with cover thumbnails and deduplication, table of contents with deep search, bookmarks, notes, full-text and regex search, light/dark/sepia themes, typography controls, footnotes, dictionary and Wikipedia lookup, OPDS catalog support, EPUB conversion and a built-in book validator.
Reading is fully offline. The only network requests are ones you explicitly trigger.
Zen mode, navigation history, OLED Black theme, persistent bookmarks, plain text and Amazon KFX export, academic citations, and new application icon.
Enables PDF support and wires up more of the ebook-rs API: regex search, deep TOC search, richer book metadata, validation, cover thumbnails, library deduplication and EPUB conversion.
